newsitem.title: USA: Intermagnetics says names Epstein COO.
newsitem.headline: Intermagnetics says names Epstein COO.

text.p: Intermagnetics General Corp said Thursday it named Glenn Epstein president and chief operating officer.
The company said Epstein most recently was president of Oxford Instrument's Nuclear Measurements Group, located in Oak Ridge, Tenn.

The company also said it has approved an extension of the full-time employment agreement with Carl Rosner, chief executive officer. That agreement, which was slated to transition to a part-time mode on May 31, has now been extended for two additional fiscal years, to May 31, 1999.
